articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds above $81,000 as oil prices hit six-month high
articles.snippet: Brent crude oil surged above $116 per barrel for the first time since late April.

articles.title: Bitcoin appears to have decoupled from midterm cycle bottom history
articles.snippet: Previous bitcoin bear-market lows followed U.S. midterms, but this year’s recovery raises the possibility that the bottom arrived months earlier.

articles.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

articles.title: Crypto is making a splash in U.S. elections — but chiefly in jabs about industry influence
articles.snippet: Boosters often say crypto voters can swing elections, but Democrats are seeking mileage out of tying crypto to Trump, corruption and attempts to buy seats in Congress.

articles.title: Ethereum’s four-minute settlement plan could lower the cost of moving crypto
articles.snippet: A new draft targets a fourfold cut in the time it takes Ethereum transactions to become final, which could free up money transfer services tie up while customers’ payments clear.
